Ryan Rollins scored the Bucks' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 16 times in 67 starts, or 24% of the games they started. AJ Green was next with 14. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
